description.value: Twins Chinese Kitchen is a sit-down Cantonese restaurant on Vancouver's Davie Street with an extensive menu spanning congee, wonton soups, fried noodles, hot pot, combo dinners, and over 80 dishes in total. The restaurant accepts online orders for takeout and is marked wheelchair accessible in OSM. It draws a steady local following with over 40 customer reviews and caters to groups with multi-person dinner combos.
